services.desc: Edelweiss Boats knows that one of the best ways to experience the city of Milwaukee is from the water. We offer a wide variety of fun and relaxing cruises that are sure to give you a completely unique experience. Traverse the waterways of the Brew City and experience historical landmarks from a new perspective Unwind after a busy day or kick off a romantic date night aboard Lake Escape, Milwaukee’s ultimate evening cruise. blurb: Edelweiss offers a variety of public cruises with unique themes and private charters for occasions like corporate outings, weddings, and birthdays. Their vessels include a 19 passenger pontoon boat with captain and deckhand. Cruises explore the Milwaukee River and the inner harbor of Lake Michigan.
